analysis.reasonEn: RSI entered oversold and bounced but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram is worsening, indicating selling pressure. ADX at 19.6 shows no trend formation, suggesting potential for shock-like volatility. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is prudent pending further directional signals.
